description.en: Effective control of the Syrian interior around Damascus; claimed area (Palestine, Lebanon, Transjordan) far larger and not controlled.
description.ar: سيطرة فعلية على الداخل السوري حول دمشق؛ أما المنطقة المطالب بها (فلسطين ولبنان وشرق الأردن) فكانت أوسع بكثير ولم تكن خاضعة لسيطرته.
description.he: שליטה אפקטיבית בפנים סוריה סביב דמשק; השטח שנתבע (פלשתינה, לבנון ועבר הירדן) היה גדול בהרבה ולא היה בשליטה.

sources.quote: elected Faisal I ... king of a united Syria (including Palestine)
On the 8th of March, the General Syrian Congress sat in Damascus and passed a resolution proclaiming the independence of Syria (including Palestine and the Lebanon) as a sovereign state

sources.locator: section 'War's Aftermath: Faisal's Rule and the Resurgence of the Local Order'
sources.quote: Proclaimed king by the Syrian Congress in March 1920, he was forced to abandon his capital four months later as the French army of the Levant under General Gouraud advanced upon it from Beirut.
French columns advanced on Damascus and entered the city on the tenth day following its presentation.
The Syrian declaration of independence in Damascus, in the congress of 7 March 1920, recognized the right of the Lebanese to preserve their own form of administration

sources.locator: section 'War's Aftermath: Faisal's Rule and the Resurgence of the Local Order'
sources.quote: Faisal’s reign in Damascus lasted twenty-two months (October 1918–July 1920) and was initiated by his father annexing Ma’an and Aqaba to the Hijaz.

sources.locator: section 'War's Aftermath: Faisal's Rule and the Resurgence of the Local Order'
sources.quote: Although local shaykhs and “petty notables” from Ma‘an, ‘Ajlun, and al-Salt took part in Damascene politics, the unified Faisalite administration established in Amman wielded little effective power.

When Palestine was occupied by the British military administration, Trans-jordania was included within the sphere of the Arab administration of Damascus, then under the Emir Feisal, now King of 'Iraq.

the High Commissioner for Palestine proceeded, in August of that year, to al-Salt and announced to an assembly of notables and sheikhs that His Majesty’s Government favoured the establishment of a system of local self-government

sources.locator: section 'War's Aftermath: Faisal's Rule and the Resurgence of the Local Order'
sources.quote: the inhabitants were to form their own administrations in each of the Salt, Karak, and ‘Ajlun districts, subject to the advice of British political officers responsible to the high commissioner in Jerusalem.

notes.en: Golan inclusion schematic, as for the preceding Arab administration. Northern and central Transjordan were part of this administration (partial unit): Luke and Keith-Roach (1922), Tell (2000), Antonius; Ma'an and Aqaba were annexed to the Hijaz.
notes.ar: إدراج الجولان تخطيطي، كما في الإدارة العربية السابقة. وكان الجزءان الشمالي والأوسط من شرق الأردن جزءاً من هذه الإدارة (وحدة جزئية): لوك وكيث-روتش (1922)، وتل (2000)، وأنطونيوس؛ أما معان والعقبة فقد ضُمّتا إلى الحجاز.
notes.he: הכללת הגולן סכמטית, כמו בממשל הערבי הקודם. צפון עבר הירדן ומרכזו היו חלק מממשל זה (יחידה חלקית): לוק וקית'-רואץ' (1922), טל (2000), אנטוניוס; מעאן ועקבה סופחו לחג'אז.
